heroDescription: A full chess.com-style Game Review — accuracy, brilliancies, blunders and the coaching behind them. Powered by Stockfish 18 running entirely in your browser. Free, no account, no server.
pastePgnDescription: Any game export — chess.com, lichess, or hand-typed moves — reviewed move by move.
importDescription: Search any player, browse their history, and pre-analyze whole batches in the background.
pgnHint: Paste a PGN (chess.com / lichess export) and let Stockfish 18 review every move — entirely in your browser.
footer: Runs 100% in your browser · Stockfish 18 Lite (GPL) · openings CC0 lichess · pieces © Chess.com (Neo)
deepReviewHint: All three options use the same machine-verified pipeline: AI wording is checked against the analysis facts; anything unverifiable keeps the standard explanation.
apiKeyPlaceholder: Anthropic API key (stays in this browser)
copyPrompt: Copy prompt for a Claude chat
replyUnreadable: The reply could not be read — keeping the standard commentary.
pasteApiKey: Paste your Anthropic API key first.
promptCopied: Prompt copied — paste it into Claude.
reviewDirections: Use ← → (or click a move) to step through the game — or move a piece to try your own idea.
keepMoving: keep moving pieces — every move gets rated
spotHint: ← → to step · Esc to return · or move a piece to try your own idea
walkthroughLimit: We keep explanations to 3 moves for now — deeper, well-explained lines are coming as the coach learns more.
opponentLeads: The expected reply is|Your opponent would likely answer|The best defense is|The opponent tries
castlingLine: castling — the king tucks away and the rooks connect
engineLiked: {move} was a fine choice — the engine just liked {best} a touch more
quip2: Checking captures, checks and threats first — like a good coach.
quip3: Hunting for brilliancies and missed wins…
quip4: Grading each move, from book to blunder…
quip5: No servers involved — your computer is doing all the work.
quip6: Measuring how the win chances swing, move by move…
quip7: Looking for the moves you’ll wish you’d seen…
quip8: Good moves get a nod. Bad moves get an explanation.
ccBlurb: Look up any account and review its games — yours, a rival's, or a streamer's. Pick several and pre-analyze them in the background while you read the first review.
accountNoGames: This account hasn't played any games yet.
backgroundQueue: runs in the background — open any game while the rest finish
noGameInPgn: No game was found in the PGN.
